# Expedia

> > Expedia is a comprehensive online travel platform offering destination guides, accommodation booking, and travel planning resources for destinations worldwide.

Expedia provides detailed travel guides for destinations across Europe, South America, and beyond, featuring cultural attractions, historical landmarks, and accommodation options including hotels, motels, and vacation rentals. The platform combines destination discovery with booking services to help travelers plan complete trips.

## Key Topics

- Portugal travel destinations
- Lisbon tourism and attractions
- Algarve beaches and coastal regions
- Porto and Douro River experiences
- Medieval castles and historical sites
- Portuguese cuisine and culture
- European vacation planning
- Montevideo and Uruguay tourism
- Beach and coastal destinations
- Accommodation booking (hotels, motels, rentals)
- Travel deals and packages
- Historic landmarks (Belém Tower, Jeronimos Monastery)
- Wine tourism (Porto wine regions)
- Cultural attractions and city tours
- South American travel destinations

## Accommodation & Booking

- [Motels: Find the best and cheapest Motels rentals](https://www.expedia.com/aa/Motels): Motel search and booking service with rentals and travel deals

## European Destinations

- [Visit Portugal: 2026 Travel Guide for Portugal, Europe](https://www.expedia.com/Portugal.dx147): Portugal travel guide featuring Lisbon, Algarve, and key attractions

## South American Destinations

- [Visit Montevideo: 2026 Travel Guide for Montevideo, Uruguay](https://www.expedia.com/Montevideo.dx2461): Montevideo travel guide covering Uruguay's capital and Ciudad Vieja
